print("scope_nodes with string:", len(scope_nodes(doc, "Video 10046")))
print("scope_nodes with dict:", len(scope_nodes(doc, node_by_title(doc, "Video 10046"))))
print("children with dict:", len(children(doc, node_by_title(doc, "Video 10046"))))

# Let's collect data from a few videos to understand physics
vids = ["Video 10046", "Video 10460", "Video 11060"]
all_data = []

for vid in vids:
    scope = node_by_title(doc, vid)
    # Use children directly since scope_nodes might be tricky
    kids = children(doc, scope)
    
    motion_node = None
    events_node = None
    for c in kids:
        if c["title"].endswith(": Motion log") and "table" in c:
            motion_node = c
        elif c["title"].endswith(": Events") and "lines" in c:
            events_node = c
            
    if not motion_node or not events_node:
        continue
        
    # Parse motion
    rows = table_rows(motion_node)
    motion = {} # (frame, oid) -> {x,y,vx,vy,speed}
    for idx, row in rows:
        f = int(row["frame"])
        m = re.match(r"(\d+)\s+", row["object"])
        if m:
            oid = m.group(1)
            motion[(f, oid)] = {"x": float(row["x"]), "y": float(row["y"]), "vx": float(row["vx"]), "vy": float(row["vy"]), "speed": float(row["speed"])}
            
    # Parse events
    events = []
    for line in events_node["lines"]:
        m = re.match(r"Frame (\d+):\s*(.+)", line)
        if m:
            f = int(m.group(1))
            rest = m.group(2)
            cm = re.match(r"Object (\d+) \((.+?)\) collides with Object (\d+) \((.+?)\)\.", rest)
            if cm:
                events.append({"f": f, "kind": "collide", "o1": cm.group(1), "o2": cm.group(3)})
            em = re.match(r"Object (\d+) \((.+?)\) exits the scene\.", rest)
            if em:
                events.append({"f": f, "kind": "exit", "oid": em.group(1)})
                
    # Analyze
    print(f"\n=== {vid} ===")
    print(f"Events: {events}")
    
    # Friction check: speed decay for moving objects
    oids = list(set(oid for (f, oid) in motion))
    for oid in oids:
        frames = sorted([f for (f, o) in motion if o == oid])
        if len(frames) < 2: continue
        speeds = [motion[(f, oid)]["speed"] for f in frames]
        # Check if friction is proportional or constant, or if metal vs rubber matters
        if speeds[0] > 0.1:
            decay = speeds[-1] / speeds[0] if speeds[0] > 0 else 0
            print(f"Obj {oid}: frames {frames[0]}->{frames[-1]}, speed {speeds[0]:.2f}->{speeds[-1]:.2f}, decay={decay:.2f}")
            
    # Collision distances
    for ev in events:
        if ev["kind"] == "collide":
            f = ev["f"]
            p1 = motion.get((f, ev["o1"]))
            p2 = motion.get((f, ev["o2"]))
            if p1 and p2:
                d = math.hypot(p1["x"]-p2["x"], p1["y"]-p2["y"])
                print(f"Collide f={f} {ev['o1']}-{ev['o2']}: dist={d:.3f}")
            else:
                # Check previous frame
                for df in [8, 4, 2, 1]:
                    p1 = motion.get((f-df, ev["o1"]))
                    p2 = motion.get((f-df, ev["o2"]))
                    if p1 and p2:
                        d = math.hypot(p1["x"]-p2["x"], p1["y"]-p2["y"])
                        print(f"Collide f={f} {ev['o1']}-{ev['o2']}: dist at f-{df}={d:.3f}")
                        break
                        
    # Exit positions
    for ev in events:
        if ev["kind"] == "exit":
            f = ev["f"]
            oid = ev["oid"]
            p = motion.get((f, oid))
            if p:
                print(f"Exit f={f} {oid}: pos=({p['x']:.2f}, {p['y']:.2f})")
            else:
                # Find last known
                last_f = max([f2 for (f2, o) in motion if o == oid])
                p = motion.get((last_f, oid))
                print(f"Exit f={f} {oid}: last known f={last_f} pos=({p['x']:.2f}, {p['y']:.2f})")
